summary: Constructor-style initializer: calls DirectXTextureCreationWithMipmapChain on `this` with size literal 8 and flag 1, then installs the vtable pointer off_5ADCDC at offset 0x0 of `this`. Returns the initialized object. Structurally identical to a sibling constructor except for the installed vtable.

operations.description: Call DirectXTextureCreationWithMipmapChain(this, a2, 8u, 1) to construct the base DirectX texture object with a mipmap chain.
Write the vtable pointer off_5ADCDC into the first DWORD of `this` (offset 0x0).

unresolved: Meaning of the size literal 8 and flag literal 1 passed to DirectXTextureCreationWithMipmapChain is not established here.
Object type owning the vtable off_5ADCDC is unknown; construction is only reachable from DirectXTextureSurfaceFactoryDispatchingFourCCCod (0x0050B8A9).
Distinction from sibling constructor sharing the same argument literals but installing a different vtable is unverified.
Semantics of argument a2 are unconfirmed; plausibly a creation/params descriptor.
